name: Hasekura Kouhei
source:
Kouhei is the protagonist of the story, and is a fifth-year student. After always transferring to other schools, he makes his way to Shuchikan Academy where he plans to stay for a while.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Arterial]Wikipedia[/url].]
